Even in the darkest of times we have the right to expect some illumination.
Thinker Hannah Arendt

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Men in Dark Times, within the tradition of Political Philosophy. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of hope, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Hannah Arendt's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
